# nemau_database_flavors (Data Source)

The database flavors the region offers, in the offer's order. Use a `name` as `flavor` of `nemau_database`. The provider does not check the flavor at plan time: the platform refuses a value the offer does not list, and a downgrade, at apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The flavors the region offers. Pick one of their names as the flavor of
# nemau_database. The provider does not check the choice at plan time.
data "nemau_database_flavors" "all" {}

output "database_flavors" {
  value = [for f in data.nemau_database_flavors.all.flavors : "${f.name} (${f.vcpus} vCPU, ${f.memory_mb} MB)"]
}
```
